title: Protection of newborn animals through maternal immunization.
ehr_evidence: Narrative review of veterinary literature on maternal immunization in animals.
summary: Narrative review discussing the use of maternal vaccination to provide passive immunity to neonatal animals (calves, puppies, piglets) against infectious diseases, highlighting safety, efficacy, and immunological mechanisms.
key_findings: No original empirical results reported; narrative review summarizing existing veterinary studies on maternal vaccine efficacy and passive immunity transfer.
limitations: focuses on veterinary models rather than human/pediatric populations
